x: Shaun Lightman managed to break away from Roy (I've forgotten what my heels are for) Court to win and Lawton held off Mal Tolley for third. Ray Middleton powered back onto the scene in 7th place and Len and John brought in our team for another team victory.

Tolley and Court took an initial lead, opening up quite a gap but Court later managed to make a break to win comfortably. Len Duquemin and John Moullin were up in the thick of it in the first six for the whole race and at five miles Smallwood was disqualified leaving three Bels in six.

From the start Roy Court went to the front and stayed there over the tough undulating course to win in a record time. Carl Lawton, performing much better than during his G.L.C. turn-out the previous week, also finished inside the old record.
